# SafeTrekr

> SafeTrekr delivers professional trip safety planning and travel risk management for K-12 schools, universities, churches, and corporate organizations. Every trip is professionally reviewed against real-time threat intelligence so coordinators, risk managers, and administrators can fulfill their duty of care with confidence.

SafeTrekr combines automated risk scoring, live threat feeds, interactive risk maps, and expert analyst review into a single workflow that replaces spreadsheets, email chains, and guesswork. The platform also provides GPS participant tracking, rally-point headcounts, emergency alerts with location, and pre-trip safety checklists.

## Platform capabilities

- [Analyst Review](https://safetrekr.com/platform/analyst-review): Comprehensive professional review of every trip.
- [Risk Intelligence](https://safetrekr.com/platform/risk-intelligence): Government-data risk scoring and live threat monitoring.
- [Safety Binder](https://safetrekr.com/platform/safety-binder): Audit-ready duty-of-care documentation.

## Solutions by organization

- [K-12 Schools](https://safetrekr.com/solutions/k12): Field trip and student travel safety.
- [Higher Education](https://safetrekr.com/solutions/higher-education): Study-abroad and faculty travel oversight, Clery Act support.
- [Churches & Missions](https://safetrekr.com/solutions/churches): Mission trip and congregational travel safety.
- [Corporate](https://safetrekr.com/solutions/corporate): Business travel risk and employee duty of care.
